svg.title: How to separate temporary and personal files when Windows storage is low
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to separate temporary and personal files when
Windows storage is low
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-22
First, check the status on the storage
screen
Go to Settings > System > Storage and check
whether the capacity bar has turned red.
Temporary files and the Recycle Bin
are automatic cleanup targets
Storage Sense is a feature that cleans up
unnecessary items such as temporary files and
items in the Recycle Bin.
Choose cleanup recommendations by
checking each item’s size
At Settings > System > Storage > Cleanup
recommendations, you can view temporary files,
large or unused files, files synchronized with…
Personal files are not automatically
cleaned up
Storage Sense does not delete files you may need
later, such as photos, documents, and videos.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
